steps.title: Analyze User Requirements
steps.description: Establish technical specifications including SQLite tables, dashboard UI requirements, and Java 8 syntax compatibility.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Generate build.gradle with correct SDK compile version 34, min SDK 21, and empty external dependencies to ensure strict local compilation.

steps.title: Establish Application Manifest
steps.description: Define package structure, standard material styles, launcher activity, and declare all sub-activities for navigation in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Color and Style Resource Files
steps.description: Write values XML files to customize primary colors, accents, and overall light theme components.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Develop DatabaseHelper.java to manage 'products' and 'sales' SQL tables, including aggregate functions for dashboard and reports.

steps.title: Define Domain Model Classes
steps.description: Write Product and Sale entity Java classes to model inventory data structures.

steps.title: Build Dashboard View and Controller
steps.description: Implement MainActivity and activity_main.xml to render beautiful summary metrics (stock, today's revenue, low stock alert) with intuitive menu tiles.

steps.title: Create Product Administration UI
steps.description: Create ProductListActivity, AddEditProductActivity, and their associated XML files to display inventory lists, handle searching, and execute creation/update forms.

steps.title: Create Product Detail Statistics Screen
steps.description: Design and write ProductDetailActivity.java to show an overall performance breakdown, stock status, and custom transactional charts for individual products.

steps.title: Create Sales Ledger UI and Cart Action
steps.description: Build SalesActivity to provide spinner-based inventory selection, automatic price calculations, stock capacity checks, and lists of transactions today.

steps.title: Develop Advanced Analytical Reports
steps.description: Implement ReportsActivity to display performance analytics, best-selling product lists, low-stock warnings, and basic daily sales history.

steps.title: Building Inventory & Sales Manager
steps.description: Compile the complete Java native solution to generate a standard, bug-free, and deployable APK.
